messages:
ana: Heads-up — thermal sensors in az21 have been trending up over the last 6 hours. Planning a brief overnight staggered node drain and reboot window to avoid hot spots. Target start 02:00 UTC. Affected pools: gpu-prod-az21-cohort-a (~120 GPUs), gpu-burst-az21 (~40). Expect some transient capacity pressure.

riley: Thanks for the flag. Is this preemptive due to fan anomalies or ambient datacenter temps?

ana: Mostly ambient rise + a handful of nodes reporting fan RPM oscillation. No SMART failures. Priority is graceful KV cache seeding after reboot to avoid regen storms. :thermometer:

priya: Can we do cohort A first and hold burst for late window? That keeps PLGs from seeing latency spikes.

ana: Yes — plan is: cohort-a 02:00-02:30 UTC (soft drains 02:00), burst pool 03:15-03:45 UTC if temps still high. Autoscale will be enabled to backfill where possible.

jonas: Any special rollback criteria? e.g., if tail latency > 300ms for 5m, abort next cohort?

ana: Good call. Rollback/hold triggers: 1) 5m P95 gen latency > 300ms for platform routes, 2) error rate > 0.5% sustained 3m, 3) ambient temp continues rising after cohort-a. If triggered we hold and escalate to infra oncall.

infra-bot: @oncall maintenance created: "az21 overnight thermal hedge" start=1766032800 (02:00 UTC) duration=90m owners=ana,riley notes="staggered drains; KV cache seed; autoscale backfill"

tom: Can ops team please add a preflight: pull KV cache footprint metric for top 3 models and pre-seed edges? I can run a quick script.

ana: Yes — tom plz run `python tools/kv_seed_preview.py --region az21 --top 3` and paste outputs here. We'll gate warmup with that.

tom: Running now. output: 
```
Top 3 models: rw-large, open-llama-13b, embed-lite
rw-large kvcache footprint: 42GB
open-llama-13b kvcache: 35GB
embed-lite kvcache: 6GB
Estimated seed time per node: ~45s
```

priya: Good. Suggest 10s delay between node reentry to spread regen. Also enable continuous batching override to 32 for cohort-a for 15m.

riley: Noted. I'll create canary traffic to cohort-a after reentry with 5% routing for 10m, then 25% if stable.

deploy-bot: deploy triggered by riley: route-weight adjustment -> cohort-a canary 5% at 1766034600

jonas: Cost question — if we enable autoscale backfill from shared pools, do we want to cap burst spending? last time this hit about ~$6k extra for 2 hours.

ana: Cap: $2,000 for the window, ops will tag costs to "thermal-hedge-az21". If projected spend > cap, we fallback to canary-only and extend hold.

priya: I will prepare docs for customer comms (short note to customers on reserved capacity).

ana: Final checklist: 1) infra-bot maintenance page up (done) 2) tom run kv preview (done) 3) priya prepare comms 4) riley orchestrate route weights 5) oncall ack. Please ack if you’re good.

riley: ack

tom: ack

priya: ack — drafting comms now

jonas: ack — will watch cost dashboards during window

infra-bot: @channel maintenance reminder scheduled for 1766030400 (30m before start).

ana: Thanks everyone. We’ll pause if any trigger hits. Posting a short postmortem template link after window for notes. :thumbsup:
